Prove the theorems in a LOGOS source file (kernel-certified).

Runs `## Theory` developments (formal Axiom/Theorem declarations, proved in citation order) and English `## Theorem` blocks (Given/Prove/Proof) through the proof engine. Every ✓ is certified by the type-theory kernel — a mere derivation never counts.

Usage: largo prove [OPTIONS] [FILE]

Arguments:
  [FILE]
          The source file (defaults to the project entry)

Options:
      --kernel
          Check FILE as a LOGOS kernel-vernacular literate document through the kernel's own document door (`Repl::execute_document`) — the form `largo lean import` emits

      --trace
          Show the rendered derivation tree under each proved theorem

      --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON results

      --certificate
          Emit the independently re-checkable proof certificate for every kernel-proved theorem as JSON (the proof term + the goal + the theorem's disclosed premises), each re-verified against the kernel. A third party can re-check these with only the kernel — no prover

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo prove                 # prove the project entry
  largo prove geometry.lg
  largo prove socrates.lg --trace
  largo prove tarski.lg --json
  largo prove socrates.lg --certificate   # emit re-checkable proof certificates
  largo prove --kernel Demo.andSwap.lg    # a kernel-vernacular document
